The ball does not become “dead” on merely hitting the Umpire unless it lodges in his pocket or clothing. Lodging in a batsman’s clothing includes practically all ways in which a ball can be said to lodge in or against his clothing. The ball ceases to be “Dead” when the bowler begins his run or bowling action.
